SELECT /* reviewed-relation-inventory */ c.relname AS name,c.relkind AS kind,c.relispartition AS partition,
      EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_inherits i WHERE i.inhrelid=c.oid OR i.inhparent=c.oid) AS inherited
    FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace
    WHERE n.nspname=$1 AND c.relkind IN ('r','p','f','m','v') ORDER BY c.relname COLLATE "C"

SELECT a.attname AS name, format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod) AS type,
       a.attidentity <> '' AS identity
     FROM pg_attribute a
     WHERE a.attrelid = to_regclass($1) AND a.attnum > 0 AND NOT a.attisdropped AND a.attgenerated = ''
     ORDER BY a.attnum

SELECT t.oid::text AS table_oid, q.oid::text AS sequence_oid,
       n.nspname AS sequence_namespace, q.relname AS sequence_name,
       a.attidentity AS identity_kind, s.seqtypid = 'pg_catalog.int8'::regtype AS bigint_sequence,
       s.seqincrement::text AS increment, s.seqmin::text AS minimum,
       s.seqmax::text AS maximum, s.seqstart::text AS start,
       s.seqcache::text AS cache, s.seqcycle AS cycle, v.last_value::text AS last_value,
       pg_get_serial_sequence($1,$2)::regclass::oid::text AS attached_oid,
       pg_has_role(current_user,q.relowner,'MEMBER') AS owns_sequence,
       has_sequence_privilege(current_user,q.oid,'UPDATE') AS can_set_sequence,
       r.rolsuper OR r.rolbypassrls OR r.rolcreaterole AS unsafe_role
  FROM pg_class t JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid=t.oid
  JOIN pg_depend d ON d.refclassid='pg_class'::regclass AND d.refobjid=t.oid
       AND d.refobjsubid=a.attnum AND d.classid='pg_class'::regclass AND d.deptype='i'
  JOIN pg_class q ON q.oid=d.objid AND q.relkind='S'
  JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=q.relnamespace
  JOIN pg_sequence s ON s.seqrelid=q.oid
  LEFT JOIN pg_sequences v ON v.schemaname=n.nspname AND v.sequencename=q.relname
  JOIN pg_roles r ON r.rolname=current_user
 WHERE t.oid=to_regclass($1) AND a.attname=$2 AND NOT a.attisdropped
